common.lab_banner: LAB test environment. No real payments, bookings, refunds, emails or SMS are produced.

catalog.title: Travel catalog
catalog.description: Ecommerce products act as trips and product options act as departures.
catalog.price_source_note: Manage prices and options in native ecommerce. Manage travel summaries, itinerary, publication and departures here.

modal.title: Departure settings
modal.price_note: Prices are not changed here. Manage them in the ecommerce product options.

metadata.title: Travel product information
metadata.no_candidates: No products to link. Create a native ecommerce product and options, or change the search.
metadata.option_hint: After linking, add departures using these option IDs. Manage options, stock, prices and the KR free-shipping policy in native ecommerce.

inquiries.title: Travel inquiries
inquiries.description: Review LAB test inquiries and move them only to allowed states.

inquiry_detail.title: Travel inquiry
inquiry_detail.description: All states are for testing only; no real booking is made.
inquiry_detail.transition_hint: Only the next states allowed by the server can be selected.
inquiry_detail.admin_note_placeholder: Internal note (never sent to the requester)

support.title: Support
support.description: Notices, FAQs and private questions run on G7 boards.

questions.title: Private questions
questions.description: Secret questions visible only to the author and admins. Answer with comments.

support.provision_hint: If the boards are missing, prepare them in LAB with raonslab-travel_lab:support-provision --lab-confirm.
